title: lane r5 operator-relayed: branch grammar is archaeology, not registered data
description: Lane round 5, operator-relayed from mdatron Part 3 (2026-07-20). Defect: the branch convention exists nowhere as contract — mdatron derived it by reading crosslink/Thermite source (type-prefixed kebab slugs; kickoff's feature/<driver-session-id>-<ref>-<slug>; crosslink/* reserved), then ratified feature/<issue#>-<slug> for hand-authored branches, leaving ONE repo with TWO grammars, and kickoff-generated branches carry no issue display ID. This is the closed-world artifact class: agents never hand-name what tooling can name, and name grammars are registration acts. Proposed: resolved-candidate (branch names join the closed-world registration — one canonical grammar as versioned data; generated branches carry the owning issue's display ID; the two-grammar live-fire drift is the motivating evidence). The kickoff --issue display-ID embedding also files upstream as an absorption proposal.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed: branch names join the closed-world registration — one canonical grammar as versioned data, generated branches carry the owning issue's display ID; the two-grammar live-fire drift cited as evidence. Display-ID embedding also filed upstream. Revision: Conformance at action time closed-world bullet.
